_about: Horse skill weights per level-up, in % before the Training bonus (bdolytics 'learn chance'). Skills listed at 100% by bdolytics are in born_with. Sprint is also treated as innate: the in-game simulator showed it as a base skill on every horse checked (2026-11-17), although bdolytics lists a weight for it; no_skill_weight already accounts for this. skill_order: the game's order of the skills (the Horse Market skill filter, read in game 2026-11-27, gives the first 29; the same order as the bdolytics table columns, which give the rest). Model and sources: docs/horse-skills-report.md.

Mythical Diné.verified: 2026-11-17, in-game simulator: Artisan 7 and Professional 10, gear/brand boxes, cap, a learned skill; all values within rounding
Mythical Diné.weights_note: bdolytics rounds weights to 0.01; refined here to 4 decimals from the in-game simulator reading tests/data/sim_mythical_dine_artisan7.csv (all within bdolytics rounding). Checked against a coupon window reading at 2 Skill Change Points (2026-11-18): every value within 0.0001 point.
